findings.problem: This file (and the matching womens/gifting copies) sits inside an `emails/` directory, so it matches the `.claude/rules/emails.md` glob `campaigns/**/emails/*.md`, which requires every matching file to be a single finished email (Subject/Preview opening lines, exactly one CTA link, sign-off + exact footer). But this is a multi-email draft/review-notes compilation, not a single finished email, so it fails nearly every rule in that file.
findings.fix: Move this file (and `groups/womens/emails/new-arrivals-christmas-2026-email-drafts.md`, `groups/gifting/emails/new-arrivals-christmas-2026-email-drafts.md`) out of any `emails/` directory — e.g. into the campaign root alongside the existing top-level drafts file, or into `notes/` — so the emails.md rule no longer wrongly applies to it.

findings.problem: Pronoun antecedent mismatch: "The Ascent Card Case is a good place to start if you're after something slim — they're simple, honest pieces..." singles out one item ("The Ascent Card Case") then switches to a plural pronoun ("they're"), presumably meaning to refer back to all four pieces. Reads as unclear/ungrammatical, not a brand-voice rule violation per se.
findings.fix: Rephrase, e.g.: "The Ascent Card Case is a good place to start if you're after something slim. All four are simple, honest pieces, finished the way we've worked leather since 1880, fifth generation now."
